Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

Read more about Tadej Pogacar’s spectacular Grand Tour debut at La Vuelta 19

Spain’s Esteban Martin won the stage and Rolf Wolfshohl retained the overall lead, en route to success a week later in Bilbao.
The last La Vuelta stage winner in Andorra la Vella is Vincenzo Nibali, on day 3 of the 2017 edition.
Last year, Andorra la Vella hosted the start of stage 7 of La Vuelta. 2021, the Tour de France also had a stage finish in Andorra la Vella, after summiting Port d’Envalira and Collada de Beixalis. Sepp Kuss took what remains the last USA Tour stage win to date.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings

[{"createdBy":"bvittek","stageType":"HMG","slug":"heading-for-encamp-forever-associated-with-pogacars-rise-to-glory","createdAt":"2026-08-25T14:51:09+02:00","title":"Heading for Encamp, forever associated with Pogacar's rise to glory","publicationAt":"2026-08-25T14:51:09+02:00","text":["Early in the stage (km 1.7), the race passes by Encamp, a few kilometres below Els Cortals d’Encamp, where Tadej Pogacar took his first Grand Tour stage win in La Vuelta 19 (stage 9), a couple of weeks before his 21st birthday.
Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

On day 11, the race went from Barcelona to Andorra la Vella, passing Collada de Toses and Port d’Envalira. Spain’s Esteban Martin won the stage and Rolf Wolfshohl retained the overall lead, en route to success a week later in Bilbao.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).

- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

On day 11, the race went from Barcelona to Andorra la Vella, passing Collada de Toses and Port d’Envalira. Spain’s Esteban Martin won the stage and Rolf Wolfshohl retained the overall lead, en route to success a week later in Bilbao.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

2021, the Tour de France also had a stage finish in Andorra la Vella, after summiting Port d’Envalira and Collada de Beixalis. Sepp Kuss took what remains the last USA Tour stage win to date.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.

2021, the Tour de France also had a stage finish in Andorra la Vella, after summiting Port d’Envalira and Collada de Beixalis. Sepp Kuss took what remains the last USA Tour stage win to date.

Since then, he has won 36 Grand Tour stages:
- 26 in the Tour
- 6 in the Giro
- 4 in La Vuelta (3 in 2019, 1 in 2026)
Today, he returns to Encamp with La Roja on his shoulders. He has earned 94 Grand Tour overall leader jerseys (71 in the Tour, 20 in the Giro, 3 in La Vuelta).
All in all, he has earned 241 distinctive jerseys in Grand Tours:
- 94 as the overall leader
- 6 as the leader of the points standings
- 59 as the leader of the KOM standings
- 82 as the leader of the young riders standings
Els Cortals d’Encamp also saw Mikel Landa take his first (and so far only) La Vuelta stage win, in 2015.
